summary: Turns the order scaffold into a working React catalog CRUD and order workflow with typed HTTP boundaries, paging, visible errors and explicit stale-form recovery.
Reserves inventory and snapshots server decimal prices in one PostgreSQL transaction; conditional versions prevent overselling and stale stock replacement.
Cancellation restores inventory once and fulfillment is final; foreign keys preserve history and order items retain purchase-time names and prices.
Adds a fresh-database migration with database constraints, strict payload/query validation, shared Prisma lifecycle and consistent request-ID errors.
Adds reproducible isolated PostgreSQL, frontend and Chromium verification, locked dependencies, reviewed responsive screenshots and nine detailed mid-level CRUD learning documents.

checks.command: npm run verify: fresh temporary PostgreSQL cluster, migration, 24 Jest cases, eight Vitest cases, five Chromium scenarios and both builds
checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; npm 10.9.2; PostgreSQL 18.1; Prisma 5.22.0; Playwright 1.60.0; isolated loopback cluster

limits: Shared local demo without authenticated ownership, request idempotency, payment processing or production deployment.
Initial migration is for a fresh database; existing installations require a reviewed data-preserving migration, which was not applied to personal data.
Supplier and PurchaseOrder remain future models without routes; inventory ledger and database-readiness checks remain exercises.
Docker, production capacity, crash recovery, power-loss behavior and failover were not verified.
